description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA and the s_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^-4)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A single blue line with diamond markers is shown, representing the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop frequency. The line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.3 at an s_pop frequency of 1, fluctuates between 0.3 and 1.0 across the x-axis, and ends at an accuracy of around 0.5 at an s_pop frequency of 19, with a peak accuracy of 1.0 at an s_pop frequency of around 5.
